jd:
L’innovation est dans notre ADN… est-elle dans le vôtre?

Bombardier est un leader mondial de l’industrie de l’aviation en créant des avions novateurs qui changent la donne sur leur marché. Ses produits et services fournissent des expériences de calibre international établissant de nouvelles normes en matière de confort-passager, d’efficacité écoénergétique, de fiabilité et de sécurité. Nous sommes une organisation mondiale axée sur la collaboration et l'esprit d'équipe.

Votre billet d’embarquement comprendra… 

Plusieurs conférences :



- Rencontrez un.e exécutif.ve
- Envolée au féminin


Apprendre davantage sur Bombardier :



- Conférence sur Les produits Bombardier 
- Visites des sites Bombardier 
- L’Académie d'apprentissage Bombardier 


De nombreuses opportunités de réseautage et d'échanges sociaux :



- Du bénévolat 
- Réseauter pour réussir
- 5 à 7, repas entre stagiaires, et bien plus encore!


Stage en intégration des essais de développement technologique EcoJet– Contrôle de vol (8 mois)

Quelles sont vos contributions envers l’équipe?



- Programmer et exécuter des vols simulés et des manœuvres de vol à l’aide du pilote automatique et de la console à main, et utiliser le simulateur de vol pendant les essais.
- Assurer l’application du profil de charge aérodynamique simulé sur les surfaces de contrôle de vol à l’aide du système de contrôle de charge, et concevoir et déployer ces profils de charge aérodynamiques selon les exigences de chaque essai.
- Assurer l’étalonnage des capteurs et l’enregistrement des données de vol et des capteurs à l’aide du système d’acquisition de données
- Effectuer le traitement, la réduction, le recoupement et la synchronisation des données provenant des différents enregistreurs de vol embarqués et du système d’acquisition de données.
- Collaborer activement avec l’équipe d’essais en vol pour maintenir la synchronisation des configurations des systèmes embarqués entre les drones d’essai en vol et l’ISTR, reproduire les pannes et les conditions de vol.
- Concevoir, fabriquer et installer des sous-systèmes de test (matériels et logiciels) pour soutenir le processus de résolution de problèmes et l’exécution des tests conformément aux exigences.
- Participer activement à la conception du système d’injection de défauts dans le contrôleur de vol expérimental et les servocommandes.
- Maintenir le carnet de bord de l’ISTR, écrire les procédures de test, les listes de vérification et les rapports de test.
- Participer activement à la conception de l’interface avec un simulateur de vol à grande échelle reconfigurable pour soutenir les premières études des entrées du pilote dans les lois de contrôle.
- Maintenir tous les systèmes (matériels et logiciels) et déployer les changements de configuration.


Comment vous épanouir dans ce rôle? 



- Vous êtes inscrit à un programme universitaire en génie électrique, mécanique ou aérospatial.
- Vous possédez une connaissance de base de la dynamique de vol conventionnelle des aéronefs et du fonctionnement du contrôle de vol, comme les ailerons, les dérives, les profondeurs, les becs, les volets, etc.
- Vous êtes rigoureux dans la planification, l'exécution et la documentation des tâches.
- Vous êtes très motivé, curieux, autonome et polyvalent.
- Vous êtes à l'aise avec plusieurs outils manuels pour installer des pièces mécaniques, modifier le câblage électrique, les connecteurs, les circuits imprimés, etc.
- Vous êtes à l'aise avec de nombreux instruments et équipements de laboratoire tels que capteurs, oscilloscopes, multimètres, etc.
- Vous maîtrisez bien l'anglais et le français.
- Vous avez une connaissance générale de Matlab, Simulink, CATIA V5 et apprenez facilement à utiliser les nouveaux logiciels.
- Vous avez des connaissances de base en C++, Python et en programmation Arduino.
- Vous avez déjà complété un programme technique collégial en génie mécanique ou en génie électrique, ou êtes diplômé de l'École nationale d'aérotechnique (atout)


 Information d’embarquement:



- Site: BAN
- Durée: 8 mois
- Travail flexible-Hybride


Il est important de noter que nos opportunités de stage sont ouvertes aux étudiants et non aux nouveaux gradués.

Tous nos stagiaires peuvent être appelés à voyager occasionnellement à l'extérieur du Canada pour des raisons de formation ou de travail.
fit_why: Flight controls test integration: aerospace/electrical hardware, flight simulators, not software

jd:
SambaNova is a leader in next-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value. About the SambaNova Summer Internship Program 
At SambaNova, our internship program is designed to give you hands-on experience tackling meaningful engineering challenges with real product impact. Because we are continuously evolving our program to provide the best possible experience, specific details and programming may vary by team and location, though you can generally expect the following: 

- Program Structure & Duration: Our summer internships are structured as a 12-week experience, kicking off with onboarding and orientation, followed by mid-program check-ins, and wrapping up with final project presentations to your team and key stakeholders. 
- Dedicated Mentorship: To support your growth, interns are typically paired with both a manager and a peer host/mentor who provide structured mentorship, technical guidance, and project alignment throughout the summer. 
- Locations & Onsite Experience: Roles are based onsite at one of our global hubs— including San Jose (HQ), Austin, Bangalore, or Stockholm—to foster direct collaboration, community, and hands-on exposure to our teams and technology. (Note: Specific location availability varies by role.) 
- Community & Engagement: Depending on your location and cohort schedule, programming may include leadership fireside chats, workshops, hackathons, lab tours, and social outings to help you connect with fellow interns and leaders across the company. 
- Feedback & Future Opportunities: Throughout the program, you will receive structured feedback on your technical depth, ownership, collaboration, and project impact. High-performing interns may be considered for returning internships or full time opportunities upon graduation, subject to business needs and performance. Machine Learning Engineer Intern About the Team 
The Machine Learning team builds the model-side techniques that make SambaNova's platform fast and capable. We train speculative decoding models that accelerate inference, develop efficient ML methods such as quantization, sparsity, and distillation, and build agentic systems on top of our foundation model serving stack. Our work spans research, applied science, and production, from novel approach design to proofs of concept and shipping to product. Reinforcement learning and post-training are within our scope and a growing part of our roadmap. About the Role 
As a Machine Learning Engineer Intern, you'll train and evaluate models that make large language models cheaper and more capable to serve. Depending on your interests, that could mean training speculator (draft) models and tuning acceptance rates, compressing models without losing accuracy, or designing and evaluating agentic workflows for tool use, planning, and long-horizon tasks. You'll work closely with the AI performance, compiler, and runtime teams, and a dedicated mentor will help you turn a research idea into a measured result. Responsibilities 

- Help train, evaluate, and tune speculative decoding models (Dspark/Dflash, Medusa/Eagle-style heads, and multi-token prediction) to increase acceptance rates on production workloads 
- Try optimization techniques, including quantization, sparsity, distillation, pruning, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and measure the trade-offs between model quality, latency, and resource efficiency 
- Help build and evaluate agentic systems: tool calling, multi-step planning, retrieval, and long-context reasoning on top of our serving stack 
- Design rigorous evaluations and benchmarks; make accuracy and quality claims that hold up under scrutiny 
- Translate recent research into working implementations, and run ablations to understand what actually drives the result 
- Partner with the AI performance, compiler, runtime, and product teams on your project 
- Explore emerging areas such as reinforcement learning, post-training, and reward modeling as the roadmap expands 
- Present your project results to the team at the end of your internship Required Qualifications 

- Currently pursuing a B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field 
- Solid programming skills in Python 
- Solid foundation in machine learning, linear algebra, probability, and numerical computing 
- Hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX 
- Working knowledge of transformer architectures and the LLM training or inference pipeline 
- Ability to design a clean experiment, interpret results honestly, and communicate findings clearly Preferred Qualifications 

- Pursuing an M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field 
- Research or internship experience in LLM training, post-training, or inference
- Experience with speculative decoding, distillation, quantization, sparsity, or other model efficiency techniques 
- Experience building agentic systems, tool-calling pipelines, or LLM evaluation harnesses 
- Familiarity with reinforcement learning or preference optimization (RLHF, DPO, GRPO, reward modeling) 
- Experience with distributed training frameworks (FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron) or inference frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM 
- Publications at ML venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP) or meaningful open source contributions  
Submission Guidelines
Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. 
EEO Policy
SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Benefits Summary for US-Based, Full-Time Employment Positions
SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

Who We Are

At Newrez, we bring big thinkers and caring doers together to make home happen. We’re a team built on heart and hustle, united by a commitment to show up for our customers, our communities, and each other. We believe that when our people thrive, homeowners thrive -and that’s why we invest in your growth, wellbeing, and ability to make an impact.

Every day, we work to exceed the expectations of our residential mortgage borrowers and business partners through superior service, simple processes, and clear communication. We do this by empowering our employees, encouraging innovative solutions and recognizing great performance.

Position Summary

FAST TRACK, Future Achievers Shaping Tomorrow Through Real-world Applied Career Knowledge, our summer internship program is 10 weeks long. The program provides rising seniors the opportunity for professional development by building relationships, gaining corporate experience, learning about our industry, and preparing students with the experience needed to have a rewarding career at our organization. The ideal candidate can see the big picture in any situation, has an entrepreneurial and process improvement mindset and can handle any situation with composure and empathy. We’re looking for assertive, well-spoken, and compassionate students who are dependable, service-minded, and results-oriented.

The Software Developer Track Star will fully immerse in the day-to-day activities of our developer teams who are responsible for the development and management of our proprietary applications. The incoming Intern can expect to use AI in their software development projects.

Essential Functions, Duties, And Responsibilities



- Contribute as a developer in a scrum team.
- Convert written and visual requirements into software code.
- Build software to design and architectural standards.
- Test code to ensure it meets the requirements.
- Support code deployment and post-production maintenance.
- Research and propose best practices, innovative approaches, notable programs of industry peers, etc.
- Performs assigned duties, under direction of experienced personnel, to gain knowledge and experience.
- Performs business analyses and provides recommendations to leadership for business and process changes.
- Receives training and performs duties in several functions in order to become familiar with line and staff functions, management viewpoints, company policies, and best practices.
- Observes experienced team members to acquire knowledge of methods, procedures, and standards required for performance of departmental duties
- Will be required to attend company sponsored training classes, activities, and events.
- Build relationships with employees and colleagues.
- Ability to effectively and accurately convey information to others.
- Performs related duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications And Education Requirements



- Currently pursuing a four-year college degree with a scheduled graduation date between Fall 2027 and Spring 2028.
- Degree in related field is preferred.

Skills, Abilities, And Knowledge



- Software code development basics.
- Knowledge of .net, c#, git and SQL
- Highly developed organizational and project/time-management skills with an ability to manage multiple priorities and meet multiple deadlines.
- Excel in a team-oriented, collaborative environment while contributing to the creation, design, and implementation of value-add business strategies that affect current operating practices and company policy.
- Be able to clearly articulate and present ideas and findings to a varied audience, including the operations staff and senior leadership.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficiency in quantitative analysis.
- Ability to adapt.
- Willingness to learn.
- An entrepreneurial business mindset.
- Strong business communication skills with an ability to work well in a collaborative environment.
- Strong attention to detail and an ability to multi-task and work well individually.
- Strong skills in Excel and/or Tableau (charts, graphs, pivot tables, formulas, macros etc.).
- Experience with PowerPoint is a plus.

Work Environment And Physical Requirements



- Working on-site at assigned office location in Coppell, TX.
- Regular and punctual attendance adhering to schedule established by leadership.
- Flexibility to work occasional adjusted work schedules, overtime, and evening and/or weekend hours to meet deadlines or as business needs demand.
- Working in a cubicle hub, maintaining focus on phone calls in a noisy environment within earshot of multiple other conversations.
- Sedentary work in a stationary position at a cubicle for prolonged periods of time.
- Constant repetitive motions required for operating a computer, such as typing and managing phone calls.
- Constantly communicating effectively verbally in English, including accurately exchanging information with others following identification of correct procedures. 

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Newrez does not consider visa sponsorship for early career program opportunities. Applicants who require sponsorship now or in the future are not eligible for this position, this includes applicants with a temporary work authorization such as F-1 students on OPT or STEM OPT.

All employees are required to have smart phones that meet Company security standards with the ability to install apps such as Microsoft Authenticator. Employment will be contingent on this requirement.
